one_line_reason: Several single-ingredient human RCTs and meta-analyses of Capsicum annuum (cayenne/paprika forms) exist on metabolic and thermogenic outcomes, with genuinely mixed results across different preparations.

selected.population: adults with metabolic syndrome and related disorders (11 RCTs, n=609)
selected.intervention: Capsicum annuum supplementation, oral, vs placebo
selected.dose_as_stated: not stated (meta-analysis pools multiple RCT doses)
selected.primary_outcome: components of metabolic syndrome (lipid profile, body weight, blood pressure, glucose)
selected.why_selected: Largest single-ingredient meta-analysis in the shortlist; found a significant LDL-cholesterol reduction and a marginally significant body-weight effect

selected.intervention: Capsicum annuum fruit powder 475 mg, oral, single dose, tested in its own arm of a 3-way crossover vs caffeine 100 mg and placebo
selected.primary_outcome: postprandial blood glucose and energy expenditure/brown adipose tissue temperature
selected.why_selected: Clean single-ingredient, dose-stated crossover trial (Capsicum tested alone, not combined with caffeine) showing restored blood glucose and increased energy expenditure comparable to caffeine

selected.intervention: cayenne pepper 500 mg (1.25 mg capsaicin), oral, single dose, crossover vs evodiamine and placebo
selected.primary_outcome: energy expenditure and fat oxidation at rest and after exercise
selected.why_selected: Clean single-ingredient, dose-stated RCT directly testing the thermogenic/fat-oxidation claim cayenne pepper is marketed for; found no significant augmentation

selected.intervention: paprika carotenoid extract (PCE) 20 mg/day (1.4 mg carotenoids), oral, 24 weeks vs placebo
selected.primary_outcome: bone turnover markers (bone resorption and formation)
selected.why_selected: Dose-stated RCT in a general (non-diseased) postmenopausal population showing a significantly greater decrease in a bone-resorption marker versus placebo

blockers: The positive and null findings come from materially different preparations (whole fruit powder, capsaicin-standardized cayenne, non-pungent capsiate analog, paprika carotenoid/oleoresin extract) that likely differ in potency and may not correspond 1:1 to a generic catalog 'cayenne pepper' capsule

37344950 (excluded below) reports an overlapping, smaller meta-analysis of the same MetS lipid question as 33262398 with a narrower positive finding (total cholesterol only), underscoring that the lipid effect is inconsistent across analyses

handoff_pmids.note: Dose-ranging (0/20/100 mg) safety and plasma-carotenoid-accumulation study of paprika oleoresin in healthy adults; a bioavailability/safety study, not a health-outcome efficacy trial

excluded_pmids.reason: Smaller, overlapping meta-analysis (4 RCTs) of Capsicum annuum on lipid profiles in metabolic syndrome; redundant with the larger 33262398 and found only a total-cholesterol effect with no change in TG/HDL/LDL

Reviews 27 different appetite-suppressing plants pooled together (green tea, Capsicum, coffee, etc.); concludes none showed a consistent positive effect, but Capsicum-specific data is not isolated in the abstract

RCT of capsiate (a non-pungent capsaicin analog) plus resistance training; found no effect on hormones, appetite, body composition, or strength beyond training alone -- included here only as corroborating null evidence, not selected because capsiate is a distinct isolated analog rather than a whole-fruit cayenne exposure
Bell pepper juice combined with yoga therapy (integrated intervention) in type 2 diabetes patients; combination intervention and clinical population, and found no significant glucose benefit
Shred-Matrix® is an 8-ingredient combination product (green tea, yerba mate, guarana, caffeine, saw palmetto, fo-ti, eleuthero, cayenne, yohimbine); not an isolated cayenne exposure
Capsaicin is used only as an experimental pain-induction tool to test an investigational H1-antagonist drug; not a study of cayenne pepper supplementation
Multi-ingredient pre-workout supplement (beta-alanine, taurine, caffeine, L-tyrosine, cayenne pepper); combination product, not isolated cayenne
